title: Prefix sums
summary: Pay once, then answer any range-sum question instantly.

cards.title: Many questions, same data
cards.body: "What's the total of values 2 to 5?" Answering by looping costs O(n) **per question**. A thousand questions? A thousand loops.

cards.title: Running totals
cards.body:
Build `prefix` where `prefix[i]` = sum of the **first i** values. So `prefix[0] = 0`.

Then the sum of `a[l..r]` = `prefix[r + 1] - prefix[l]`: everything up to r, minus everything before l. **One subtraction**, no loop.

cards.title: The code
cards.body: The prefix array has **n + 1** entries. The extra `prefix[0] = 0` removes a special case for ranges starting at 0.

cards.title: The slot connection
cards.body: Reel weights `[40, 30, 20, 10]` become running totals `[40, 70, 90, 100]`. Pick a random number from 0 to 99, then find the first running total bigger than it (binary search!). That's how weighted symbols are picked. Prefix sums and binary search together.
